0.name: TEXT_REGWILHORIZON_00057_GISELBERDUS_000
0.description: Lost, are you? If you want to know something, go ahead and ask.

3.name: TEXT_REGWILHORIZON_00057_SCENE00000A2
3.description: What kind of place is Horizon?

5.name: TEXT_REGWILHORIZON_00057_GISELBERDUS_010
5.description: Serve and protect, of course! The Brass Blades of the Rose keep the peace here in Horizon.

6.name: TEXT_REGWILHORIZON_00057_GISELBERDUS_011
6.description: We ensure that merchants can conduct their affairs in safety. They compensate us well for our swords.

7.name: TEXT_REGWILHORIZON_00057_GISELBERDUS_012
7.description: We get coin, the merchants get kept out of harm's way. Everybody profits.

8.name: TEXT_REGWILHORIZON_00057_GISELBERDUS_020
8.description: It's busy as hells, that's what it is! Horizon's a waypoint for all traffic between Ul'dah and Vesper Bay. Everything loaded and unloaded at the docks passes through here.

9.name: TEXT_REGWILHORIZON_00057_GISELBERDUS_021
9.description: The constant stream of goods is why the merchants had that contraption installed in the Sunset Gate. Hauling cargo up and down that ramp is backbreaking work.

10.name: TEXT_REGWILHORIZON_00057_GISELBERDUS_022
10.description: Aye, thanks to all this trade, Horizon's grown quite prosperous over the years. A lot of folk have gathered here as a result, not all of whom have good intentions.

11.name: TEXT_REGWILHORIZON_00057_GISELBERDUS_023
11.description: Which is why <hex:021A020203>we<hex:021A020103> are here, adventurer. Without us, this settlement would've been sacked long ago.
